environment.description: Flask application deployed on a Kubernetes cluster behind a standard nginx ingress controller (ingress-nginx v1.9.4) with no authentication requirements. The service is exposed via ClusterIP with an ingress rule matching path /api/v1/migrations/*. No network policies restrict pod-to-pod communication. The application runs as a single replica with in-memory cache (MIGRATION_CACHE dict). Any client with network access to the ingress can POST to the migrations endpoint.
